families.targets: Reconstruct local PBP outcomes including overtime, kneels, spikes and identifiable lateral yards. Use explicit scorer IDs for offensive TDs. Only PBP participants or uniquely PFR-to-GSIS-mapped offensive snap participants establish known zero labels. Never use target-week participation as a feature/eligibility criterion. Ambiguous lateral yard games, missing scorer IDs and wrong-team candidates are quarantined per affected target; unknown outcomes remain NaN. No independent official box-score table exists locally: label reconstructed, not settlement-certified. Compare legacy/fixed labels descriptively, never call changed targets an accuracy gain.
families.provider: Same corrected known-label cohort, task-specific NFL-only versus NFL+FPDS; fixed lab hist model (80 iterations,depth3,l2=10), season weights unchanged. Six primary comparisons. Training/evaluation unknown labels excluded identically and counted. Existing lagged base features retained; no old forecast/target overwrite.
families.role: Add strictly earlier last1/3/8 opportunity/share means, CV, last1 vs preceding3 ratio, verified earlier team/QB change and timestamp-verified injury flags to FPDS hist baseline. No tuning. Six comparisons; role change fixed abs(last1/previous3-1)>.5, lower denominator1; finite earlier usage only.
families.role_mixture: Draw empirical prior player workload ratios (last8 played games, normalized to mean1, clipped .25–2), not invented availability probabilities. Counts use Poisson conditional on sampled role; TD uses intensity scaling; yardage uses scaled baseline mean plus earlier OOF residual. Earlier injury Out creates a separately labelled zero-usage scenario, no guessed replacement. Low/base/high role scenarios have unknown occurrence probabilities; replacement mass stays other players. Six CRPS/Brier comparisons vs unscaled marginal draws; point means/medians secondary.
families.shared: Same marginal baseline distributions, Gaussian copula from earlier whole-game OOF residual ranks across three game and six prop aggregates, identity shrinkage .5, >=100 earlier games otherwise identity. One latent game vector per sim shared across all players, then independent player noise with fixed shared loading .5. Correlated and independent arms use common random numbers. Six marginal CRPS/Brier comparisons and one primary multivariate energy-score comparison of nine standardized game/stat aggregates. No claim that correlations alone improve point means; no hard reconciliation.
families.drives: Local earlier regulation drives as empirical (offensive points,opponent points) events, including defensive/special-teams scoring in scoreboard increments. Require extracted increments to match local final game scores, quarantine unmatched games. Sample paired possession counts from earlier games. Opponent-adjusted event weights = league frequency times shrunk offense and defense relative frequencies, 80 league pseudo-drives; fixed floor. Tied regulation simulations draw earlier actual OT score increments; OT sample size/tie probability reported. Three comparisons versus saved strict A8 NFL-only game forecasts. Winner Brier, margin/total MAE primary; CRPS, common margins/totals reliability secondary. No closing prices as inputs.
families.groups: Earlier-OOF residual intervals for passing/receiving/rushing yards, split by position and pregame role-change flag only when>=200 earlier group rows, otherwise earlier stat pool>=100, else earlier training residual warmup. Finite-sample 80% conformal widening. Three interval-score comparisons against global-only calibration, plus per-group coverage/width. Binary probability reliability by group diagnostic only. No adaptation using2026 outcomes.

inference: 2000 whole-game paired bootstrap draws; family-wise Bonferroni95%CI and Holm p, fixed comparison counts provider6,role6,role_mixture6,shared7,drives3,groups3. Exploratory nominee only >=1% primary loss reduction, corrected upperCI<0, Holm p<.05, >=200 games, same direction>=2/3seasons, identical eligible corrected targets, all blocks complete/no family failures. Groups additionally >=.78 coverage. No promotion. Revised historical FPDS and examined seasons limit inference.
metrics: Yards MAE/pinball10/50/90/coverage, counts Poisson deviance, probabilities Brier/logloss. Simulation primary CRPS for nonbinary, Brier for anytimeTD; energy score evaluates joint aggregates separately. Accuracy secondary. Official closing games.csv lines benchmark only. No historical prop prices or betting-return claims.
prospective: Optional explicit project command refits identical frozen parameters on known outcomes available before creation time through completed source weeks only. May read2025/2026 only for this fit; never evaluate/tune/select on them. New private shadow revision, creation time/training cutoff/config+source hashes in every output. Future week without prepared pregame candidates fails clearly. Existing champion/simulator/default forecasts unchanged.
runtime: Local Idle priority, cores-2, default2h maximum3h, five-minute step admission buffer, checkpoints immutable; failure logged/skipped, no retry or silent dropping. No API, downloads, site login, secrets or raw FPDS publication.
